_comment: Side-wheel paddle steamer. Particulars seeded from docs/steamer-spec.md section 2; 'form' holds the shape parameters steamer_form.py iterated until the section-2 acceptance ranges passed. Ship frame: +z bow, +y up, +x starboard, origin = centreline / design waterline / LWL midpoint.

form._comment: Level-wise plan shapes: hb = bmax(y) * (1 - s^a)^b, s = distance past the parallel body / distance to the profile end at that height. (a, b) blend keel -> waterline -> knuckle (= main-deck sheer line); above the knuckle they hold, so the forecastle side is near-vertical over a strongly flared bow.
